summary: A command, and so fate as Heaven’s command; also a lifespan. 天命 and 司命 are its two great compounds.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Lorenz-84 trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 望 takes the highest point, gazing up; 劫 the point farthest from the rest, at the edge of the eon. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: What Heaven Commands Is Called Nature
satellites.evidence: The Zhongyong opens: 天命之謂性，率性之謂道，修道之謂教 — “what Heaven commands is called nature; following nature is called the Way; cultivating the Way is called teaching.”

satellites.title: Death and Life Have Their Decree
satellites.evidence: Analects 12.5: to Sima Niu, grieving that he has no brothers, Zixia says 死生有命，富貴在天 … 四海之內皆兄弟也 — “death and life have their decree, wealth and rank lie with Heaven … within the four seas all are brothers.”
